meta.name: dev-browser
meta.description: Browser automation with persistent page state. Use when users ask to navigate websites, fill forms, take screenshots, extract web data, test web apps, or automate browser workflows. Trigger phrases include "go to [url]", "click on", "fill out the form", "take a screenshot", "scrape", "automate", "test the website", "log into", or any browser interaction request.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页交互与数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制浏览器执行重复操作
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions and extract web data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control a browser programmatically for repetitive tasks

howto.what: Claude 能操控一个浏览器:打开网页、点击、填表、截图、读取页面内容,并在多次操作间保留页面状态,分小步完成任务。
howto.when: 当用户要求打开网址、点击、填表、截图、抓取数据、测试网站或登录,或说出“go to [url]”等触发语时。

say.text: 打开 example.com,页面加载后截一张全屏图。
say.note: 会新建页面并保存截图。

say.text: 在示例商店页面上点击“加入购物车”按钮。
say.note: 会先获取页面快照,再定位并点击。

say.text: 抓取这个网页上的新闻标题,保留前 10 条。
say.note: 会读取页面内容并整理成列表。

howto.what_en: Claude can control a browser: open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots, read page content, and keep page state across operations, completing tasks in small steps.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to browse websites, click, fill forms, screenshot, scrape, test, log in, or says trigger phrases like "go to [url]", "click on", "take a screenshot", etc.

say_en.text: Open example.com and take a full-page screenshot after it loads.
say_en.note: Creates a page, navigates, and saves the screenshot.

say_en.text: Click the "Add to cart" button on the sample store page.
say_en.note: Finds the element via snapshot and clicks it.

say_en.text: Scrape the news headlines from this page, keeping the first 10.
say_en.note: Reads page content and outputs a list.
